cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
